fixes.what: Sicily is owned twice: the aggregate keeps the Syracusan cells -700..-211 and loses 'Siracusa' to Rome in -212, while syracuse.json (found -733 from nobody) holds the same land and is the counterpart Rome names.
fixes.why: syracuse.json: -733 found, -405 gain from greek-city-states (eastern Sicily), -386 gain from greek-city-states (Rhegium), -367 loss to greek-city-states (Adriatic colonies), -212 Oct loss/dissolve to roman-republic; roman-republic.json /ledger/55: -212 gain from syracuse. GCS keyframe 39 note: 'Syracuse's kingdom (9 Sicilian cells)' kept in the aggregate. The author flagged the overlap but did not resolve it.
fixes.fix: Subtract syracuse.json's land from the keyframe corrections for the years it holds it (from -733; Hieron's kingdom -271..-212); add the mirrors: -405 loss (eastern Sicily) to syracuse, -386 loss (Rhegium) to syracuse, -367 gain (the Adriatic colonies) from syracuse; delete /ledger/31 or reduce it to the non-Syracusan cells.

fixes.what: The Peloponnese is owned twice -191..-146: GCS keyframes subtract only Laconia, while achaean-league.json draws the whole Peloponnese from 191 and gains its members from greek-city-states; GCS has no loss to achaean-league at all.
fixes.why: achaean-league.json /keyframe_review/10 correction union Peloponnese ('the whole Peloponnese from 191'); its ledger: -251 gain Sicyon from greek-city-states (c3), -243 Corinth, Megara, Troezen, Epidaurus (c2), -235 Megalopolis (c3), -234 Arcadia (c1), -191 Messene and Elis (c1). GCS -164 keyframe note: '71,000 km2 of it in Greece'; roman-republic.json /ledger/81 takes the Peloponnese in -146 from achaean-league while GCS /ledger/35 also loses it.
fixes.fix: Add losses to achaean-league at -251, -243, -235, -234, -191; subtract the Achaean League's corrected shape from keyframes -251..-145; restrict /ledger/35 to the land the aggregate still held (Thessaly, central Greece outside the leagues, Euboea).

fixes.what: Philip II's conquests of Greek cities are absent: Macedon records three confidence-3 gains from greek-city-states with no mirror, and the Chalcidice is never lost.
fixes.why: macedonian-empire.json /ledger/3 -357 gain from greek-city-states (Amphipolis, Pydna), /ledger/4 -356 (Crenides/Kavala), /ledger/5 -354 (Methone), all c3; /ledger/7 -348 gain Chalcidian League (Polygyros 50 km). GCS keyframe -350 is 'ok' at 144,364 km2 with no event between -355 and -338 other than /ledger/21.
fixes.fix: Add losses to macedonian-empire at -357 (Amphipolis, Pydna), -356 (Crenides), -354 (Methone) and -348 (Olynthus and the Chalcidice, or counterpart chalcidian-league if eu-01-x writes it), citing the pages Macedon cites.

fixes.what: The League of Corinth and the Diadochi years disagree with macedonian-empire.json in type and, at -307, in direction.
fixes.why: macedonian-empire.json: -337 vassal_start greek-city-states (Central Greece, Attica, Peloponnese), -323 vassal_end, -322 vassal_start, -307 vassal_end; GCS records -338 loss, -323 gain, -322 loss and -307 LOSS (Thessaly and the Peloponnese), plus a -319 gain Macedon does not mirror. GCS keyframe 22 itself says the members 'should be drawn as Macedonian tint rather than colour', and /ledger/28 cites a page that says Demetrius 'freed the city' (a release, not a loss).
fixes.fix: Agree one model with eu-02: record vassal_start/vassal_end of macedonian-empire (-338/-337, -323, -322, -307 Attica) and keep the mainland in the keyframes as vassal land, or have eu-02 change its events to gain/loss; rewrite /ledger/28 so it does not contradict its own page, and pair /ledger/27 with a Macedon event.

fixes.what: The Italiot cities in 272 are a loss here but a vassal_start in roman-republic.json, and Rome's -90 vassal_end of greek-city-states has no mirror.
fixes.why: Pyrrhic War page: 'the remaining cities quickly seeking terms'; 'the Romans taking allies from Tarentum in the form of Locri, Croton, and Rhegium'. roman-republic.json /ledger/24 -272 vassal_start greek-city-states (Taranto, Reggio, Napoli), /ledger/99 -90 vassal_end greek-city-states.
fixes.fix: Change /ledger/30 to vassal_start (counterpart roman-republic, region Taranto, Reggio, Napoli) and add the -90 vassal_end plus the loss of those cities at the Social War enfranchisement, matching the Rome dossier.

fixes.what: Ionia is lost twice (-547 to Persia, -478 to the Delian League) with no regain between, and the -480 keyframe already excludes the Aegean and Ionian cities.
fixes.why: /ledger/11 -547 loss Ionia (confirmed: 'conquest of all the Ionian cities in 547 BC'); no event for Mycale (479); /keyframe_review/13 text: 'the Aegean and Ionian cities are absent'. delian-league.json /ledger/1 records -478 vassal_start with counterpart 'Delian League allies', not greek-city-states.
fixes.fix: Either add a -479 gain of Ionia from achaemenid-empire (Mycale) or drop Ionia from /ledger/15; agree with delian-league on vassal_start (counterpart greek-city-states) versus loss for 478 and 404.

fixes.what: Attica leaves the aggregate in the keyframe at -377 but not in the ledger, then is gained back from the Second Athenian League at -338.
fixes.why: /keyframe_review/19 subtracts the whole Second Athenian League -366 shape; /ledger/19 region is that shape minus Attica; /ledger/23 gains Attica from second-athenian-league in -338.
fixes.fix: Include Attica in /ledger/19 (Athens leaves with its league), or keep Attica in keyframe 19 and drop /ledger/23.

fixes.what: Messenia leaves the aggregate in 724 by the keyframe's own note, but the correction keeps it to -701 and no event records it.
fixes.why: /keyframe_review/1 note: 'Messenia stays in the aggregate until the First Messenian War ends in 724'; peloponnesian-league.json /ledger/1: -724 gain Messenia from greek-city-states (c2).
fixes.fix: Add -724 loss of Messenia to peloponnesian-league and a new keyframe -724..-701 = GCS -750 minus Laconia and Messenia.

fixes.what: Messenia is gained in -369 but the -366 keyframe ('ok') draws it, with Arcadia and Thessaly, in the Sacred Band of Thebes row; the -377 to -366 area fall of about 15,000 km2 has no event and no event returns the land at -350.

fixes.fix: Either adjust keyframe 20 to keep Messenia and Arcadia in the aggregate with Theban tint (vassal_start of sacred-band-of-thebes) or add losses to sacred-band-of-thebes at -366 and gains at -350.

fixes.what: Boeotia is gained at -335 from sacred-band-of-thebes while keyframes 22-25 already add it from -337, and the row alive in -350..-338 is 'Thebans'.

fixes.fix: Either keep Attica in the aggregate after 1 March 86 (adjust keyframes -87..-42 to union Attica) and delete /ledger/39, or hand Athens to the proposed 'athens' dossier with a dated event.
